reason: I already have a country picked out and no pipeline there, and a junior SDR with Apollo would take three months just to learn freight. EUR 1,500 at risk, with the free 15-company sample first, is less than one trade fair stand, so I'll take the sample and sign if the list looks like real shippers.
objection: Your 'qualified meeting' could still be a polite 20-minute call with a logistics manager who has a contract running two more years. Meetings are cheap. Freight lanes and contracts are what I need, and I've paid agencies before who filled my calendar with tourists.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are names I already know or obvious ones from a directory, or if the past client won't take my call, I walk away.
